title: edit-parse-rule and disable-parse-rule command result

revision.description: The rule's version: the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over its Match, Strategy and CleanupRules as stored (processing design §3.5).

changed.description: False when the rule already had this content and state: nothing was written, audited or enqueued.

reprocessSyncs.description: sync reprocess jobs requested, one per active source with parser-route documents in the old or the new scope; one already queued under sync:{sourceId} absorbs its request.

description: Result of the commands edit-parse-rule and disable-parse-rule: the rule as it is now (its parse-stage id is profileId@revision) and the number of reprocess syncs enqueued for the sources it re-keys.
